reasoning: BSP4(outline 11.5)規定第一個 home screen 為 Default Home Screen(HSD1),品牌頁接續其後。037 給本條的 title 是「Home Screen Locking」,但 BSP4 的內文只講順序,完全沒有提到鎖定或禁止重排——title 蘊含的「使用者不能把品牌頁移到第一頁」是規格從未主張的行為(A-H24)。本條因此只驗規格明文承諾的順序:第一頁為 Default Home Screen,品牌頁在其後。不加入重排嘗試步驟,那會斷言未定義行為;若確實存在鎖定約束,它需要自己的需求條目,已列為 RD-1。與 074 的界線:074 驗多個品牌頁彼此之間的先後,本條驗 Default Home Screen 與品牌頁之間的先後,兩者觀察對象不同,不重複。優先級:第一頁是開機後的落點,屬核心版面約束,訂 P1。

distinguishing_axis.delta: 074 orders brand pages among themselves; 075 orders the Default Home Screen ahead of all brand pages

coverage_notes: 037's title says 'Home Screen Locking' but BSP4 states only an ordering rule; no reorder constraint is asserted (A-H24).

tcs.test_item:
The system shall implement Home Screen Locking: BSP4.) The first home screen should be the Default Home Screen (HSD1) and Branded Pages should follow.

(Vehicle equipped with a brand specific Default Page -> the first Home Screen page is the Default Home Screen and the brand page follows it)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle speed is 0
2. The vehicle is equipped with a brand specific Default Page
3. The Home Screen configuration is at factory default
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Navigate to the Home Screen
2. Read the first Home Screen page
3. Swipe to the next Home Screen page and read it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Home Screen is displayed
2. The first Home Screen page is the Default Home Screen
3. The brand specific page is displayed after the Default Home Screen page

tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
